Group news

  • 9 Nov 2026
    Penny joins CityUHK Green Week fireside chat

    Prof. Penny Han joined the public seminar on Climate Change & Antarctic Research as a fireside chat panelist at City University of Hong Kong.

  • 15 Oct 2026
    Invited talk at Hohai University

    Penny presented “Microbial Nitrogen Cycling under Environmental Change: From Grasslands to Groundwater and Coastal Ecosystems” at the College of Geography and Remote Sensing, Hohai University, Nanjing.

    Welcome to Linao Zhu, Zhengyao Hu, and Fangyi Liao as they begin their PhD journeys. Wishing them every success in their research!

    HAN Lab research at ISME20

    Penny presented “Ecophysiology and niche adaptation of comammox Nitrospira in acidic agricultural soils” at the 20th International Symposium on Microbial Ecology in Auckland, New Zealand.

  • Jul 2026
    Yunqiu presents at the Summer School of Future Ocean

    Sustainable cities in a changing climate

    Representing CityUHK, Penny spoke on the Cities and Communities Panel at the Global Sustainable Development Congress in Jakarta. The discussion explored extreme weather and urban resilience; related SEE research was featured in Times Higher Education.

    We welcomed Professor Lisa Stein to HAN Lab from 2 to 6 May 2026 for a distinguished lecture and discussions with colleagues.
